name: Popular Estate Management Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Popular Estate Management does construction & development of buildings and infrastructure[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company started as a financial services provider and changed to software and IT related sector. At present, it deals in Real Estate, Construction and Infrastructure related projects. Company has developed many residential and commercial projects including plotting for residential localities in Ahmedabad

pros: Stock is trading at 0.67 times its book value
